title: Proper base change for higher direct images of a module on a ringed space, computed on the fibre
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Let f: X to Y be a morphism of ringed spaces which is closed and separated with quasi-compact fibres; the lemma identifies the stalk at y of the higher direct images of a bounded below complex E with the derived global sections of the restriction of E to the fibre over y (statement lines 3058-3070). The base change map is available from a previous lemma, so the content is the proof that it is an isomorphism. The author resolves E by a bounded below complex of injectives, and the three hypotheses are exactly what makes the restrictions of the injectives to the fibre acyclic for the global section functor, so that the right hand side is represented by the complex of sections over the fibre (proof lines 3072-3084). What remains is the comparison of a colimit over the neighbourhoods of the fibre with the sections over the fibre itself, and the closedness of f supplies the cofinality: given a neighbourhood U of the fibre, the complement of the closed image of X minus U gives a neighbourhood V of y with f^{-1}(V) contained in U (proof lines 3085-3097). The claim is H2: one bookkeeping reduction plus a cofinality argument whose shape is forced by closedness.
